purpose: Selective, self-contained vendoring of the pure-doc OilOil UI/UX Guide consultation skill (design/guide/review modes) for offline reference. Only the locked skills/oiloil-ui-ux-guide subtree plus the Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt are copied byte-for-byte; no upstream installer/setup is run, no home/global write, no network fetch during use.

source.commitSubject: 明确 Skill 功能、首次使用与执行边界 (#1)
source.fetchMethod: Public read-only codeload tarball of the locked commit (https://codeload.github.com/oil-oil/ui-ux-guide/tar.gz/f32bc2bd210a6693f86841816a531ab511b258b4) extracted to .tmp; only the allowed subtree and LICENSE.txt copied into vendor. No git remote added, no fork, no write/push to upstream, no npx/skills CLI, no home clone.

license.copyright: Apache License 2.0 standard text; upstream author Zhihuang Lin (commit f32bc2b); no NOTICE file present at the locked commit.
license.verified: Root LICENSE.txt read and confirmed Apache License Version 2.0 (11358 bytes); copied verbatim. Note: the current static verifier only whitelists MIT and the exact basename LICENSE; Apache-2.0/LICENSE.txt is a known verifier gap reported to the parent, not a license mismatch.

projectRulesPriority.statement: Project AGENTS.md, docs/collaboration.md and docs/external-skills.md are authoritative and override any vendored OilOil guidance whenever they conflict.
upstreamSkillsDoNotGrant: running the upstream npx `skills add oil-oil/ui-ux-guide` installer or any global/home clone
writing $HOME, global, IDE or shell config
imposing a style family (e.g. modern-minimal) or a font ban as a global hard rule on this project
self-issuing PASS or replacing the independent test gate (ADL-045)
modifying upstream deepseek-harness, data/, or pushing to a remote
treating OilOil review conclusions as acceptance; P0/P1/P2 findings are candidate defects only
projectRulesPriority.conflictResolution: Where the vendored playbook suggests behavior the project forbids (installer, home/global write, style-family imposition, self-certified PASS, network fetch to align upstream), project rules win and the playbook is reference only.

skills.name: oiloil-ui-ux-guide
riskNotes: references/design-preview-template.html contains inline client-side demo JS and loads a Google Fonts CSS URL only when a webfont family is chosen inside a local Phase 4a preview; it references an agent-generated /tmp/design-config.js that is NOT vendored. No credential, no installer, no exfiltration; the template is opened locally for exploration only and is not executed by the vendoring process.
evals/evals.json is static upstream behavioral test data; it is not executed by this project.

SKILL.md Phase 0 instructs scanning project files (package.json, tailwind.config, theme.ts, globals.css, design-spec.md/DESIGN.md/AGENT.md); these are external project files read-only, not vendored dependencies.

references/business-mockup-contract.md suggests writing a session temp preview under /tmp and `open`-ing it on macOS; /tmp is session scratch, not home/global; output location remains governed by project rules.
Per-family '禁止/推荐' lists inside style-families/*.md are scoped to that chosen family only; they are never global UX rules and must not be quoted against a project that picked a different family.

externalProjectReferences.note: Phase 0 framework scan input; project file, not vendored. Absence permitted.
Phase 0 token scan inputs; project files, not vendored.
Phase 0 reads existing design docs if present; project files, not vendored. design-spec.md/design-spec-components.md are also agent-generated Phase 5 outputs, not upstream files.
